x: Aadhaar's open APIs are authentication, e-KYC and e-Sign (under MeitY's Policy on Open APIs, 2015, via API Setu). GIS decision support is not one of the Aadhaar open API services.

Excessive digital literacy is not a stated challenge. The criticisms listed for BharatNet are Gram Panchayats still waiting for connectivity, weak last mile, low commercial viability and the digital divide.

e-Courts is an Integrated Mission Mode Project under NeGP, not a Ministry of Commerce and Industry programme of 2016, so this pair is wrong. e-Panchayat is an MMP, IVFRT is an MHA MMP of 2010 and CCTNS an MHA MMP of 2009.

e-Pathshala is an NCERT platform for e-textbooks and educational resources. DIKSHA is an NCERT/Ministry of Education platform (not Health), Shiksha Vani is a CBSE podcast app (not a MoRTH licence portal), and SWAYAM is the Ministry of Education's MOOC platform (not a CBSE podcast).

AP Grama/Ward Sachivalayam is cited as a digital-governance model. The other pairs are wrong: I4C (MHA), not WHO, runs the SAHYOG takedown portal; the EU AI Act mandates watermarking of AI content; and WHO, not ECI, lists Gaming Disorder in ICD-11.
